purpose: Realistic competing skill descriptions for the trigger smoke test. A judge is shown a query, the research description, and these distractors, and routes the query. Research should win its should-trigger queries (assets/trigger-evals.json should_trigger) and lose the near-misses (should_not_trigger).

distractors.name: markdown
distractors.description: Create and reformat Markdown files into clean, platform-tailored Markdown. Use when writing or tidying a .md file, a README, or notes.

distractors.name: deep-research-generic
distractors.description: A generic web-research helper: fetch a few pages on a topic and summarize them. No team, no fact-checking, no calibrated certainty.

distractors.name: code-assistant
distractors.description: Read, write, refactor, debug, and explain source code in any language. Use for programming tasks and fixing bugs.

distractors.name: creative-writing
distractors.description: Draft stories, poems, scripts, and other creative prose from a prompt.

distractors.name: quick-answer
distractors.description: Answer arithmetic, conversions, and established-fact lookups directly from knowledge, no sources needed.

distractors.name: translate
distractors.description: Translate text between languages and explain idioms.
